biotools.summary: ECMpy 2.0 is a Python package that automates the construction and analysis of enzyme-constrained models (ecModels) for microorganisms, significantly improving upon traditional genome-scale metabolic models (GEMs). It streamlines parameter retrieval and integrates algorithms for metabolic engineering target discovery.
